name: Ray Marching Volume Rendering with Geometry Occlusion
definition: A front-to-back ray marching technique that renders a 3D volume texture by stepping along rays from the camera, compositing color and opacity, and using pre-rendered opaque geometry to occlude the volume and adjust sampling rates.
summary: A front-to-back ray marching technique that uses pre-rendered opaque geometry to occlude volume rendering and adjust sampling rates, solving self-occlusion without full volumetric integration.
